name: Ring Jenny AI Receptionist and Answering Service
tagline: AI receptionist for missed calls at Australian service businesses
description:
When your team is busy, unavailable or closed, Ring Jenny can handle forwarded missed calls so callers can ask questions or leave a message. Ring Jenny is an AI receptionist and answering service for Australian businesses. It answers calls 24/7 while letting a business keep its existing phone number.

Jenny learns business information from a website or Google Business Profile. Businesses can customise the greeting and FAQs about services, opening hours and other common enquiries. Call recordings, transcripts, and text and email summaries help the team review conversations and follow up with callers. Spam filtering is included.

On eligible plans, Jenny can check calendar availability, book appointments, send texts and warm-transfer callers to the appropriate person. A free plan includes 5 minutes per month; paid plans provide additional minutes and features.

Book a demo to discuss your call-handling needs: https://lunacal.ai/ring-jenny/quick-support
